final_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Codigo) AS cantidad_ordenes_enviadas FROM oc_lineas WHERE FechaEnvio >= '2026-01-01' AND FechaEnvio < '2026-02-01' LIMIT 100
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CodigoOrganismoPublico) AS cantidad_organismos_publicos FROM oc_lineas LIMIT 100
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Codigo) AS cantidad_ordenes_agiles FROM oc_lineas WHERE EsCompraAgil = 'Si' LIMIT 100
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Codigo) AS cantidad_ordenes_canceladas FROM oc_lineas WHERE Estado = 'Cancelacion solicitada' LIMIT 100
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Codigo) AS cantidad_ordenes_canceladas FROM oc_lineas WHERE Estado = 'Cancelacion solicitada' LIMIT 100
SELECT (COUNT(CASE WHEN EsTratoDirecto = 'Si' THEN Codigo END) * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT Codigo)) AS PorcentajeTratosDirectos FROM oc_lineas LIMIT 100

WITH ordenes_deduplicadas AS (SELECT Codigo, ANY_VALUE(MontoTotalOC_PesosChilenos) AS MontoTotalComprado, ANY_VALUE(FechaEnvio) AS FechaEnvio FROM oc_lineas WHERE FechaEnvio >= '2026-01-01' AND FechaEnvio < '2026-02-01' GROUP BY Codigo) SELECT SUM(MontoTotalComprado) AS MontoTotalComprado FROM ordenes_deduplicadas LIMIT 100

WITH ordenes_deduplicadas AS (SELECT Codigo, ANY_VALUE(MontoTotalOC_PesosChilenos) AS MontoTotalComprado, ANY_VALUE(Estado) AS Estado FROM oc_lineas WHERE FechaEnvio >= '2026-01-01' AND FechaEnvio < '2026-02-01' GROUP BY Codigo) SELECT SUM(MontoTotalComprado) AS MontoTotalComprado FROM ordenes_deduplicadas WHERE Estado IN ('Recepcion Conforme', 'Aceptada') LIMIT 100

WITH deduplicated_orders AS (SELECT Codigo, ANY_VALUE(MontoTotalOC_PesosChilenos) AS MontoTotalOC_PesosChilenos, ANY_VALUE(OrganismoPublico) AS OrganismoPublico, ANY_VALUE(sector) AS sector FROM oc_lineas WHERE sector = 'Salud' GROUP BY Codigo) SELECT OrganismoPublico, SUM(MontoTotalOC_PesosChilenos) AS TotalComprado FROM deduplicated_orders GROUP BY OrganismoPublico ORDER BY TotalComprado DESC LIMIT 5
SELECT TRIM(RegionUnidadCompra) AS Region, COUNT(DISTINCT Codigo) AS NumeroDeOrdenes FROM oc_lineas GROUP BY Region ORDER BY NumeroDeOrdenes DESC LIMIT 5
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CodigoProveedor) FROM oc_lineas WHERE sector = 'Salud' LIMIT 100

WITH deduplicated_orders AS (SELECT Codigo, ANY_VALUE(MontoTotalOC_PesosChilenos) AS MontoTotalOC_PesosChilenos, ANY_VALUE(NombreProveedor) AS NombreProveedor, ANY_VALUE(es_persona_natural) AS es_persona_natural FROM oc_lineas WHERE DescripcionTipoOC = 'Proveniente de Ficha de Trato Directo' GROUP BY Codigo) SELECT NombreProveedor, es_persona_natural, SUM(MontoTotalOC_PesosChilenos) AS TotalMontoRecibido FROM deduplicated_orders GROUP BY NombreProveedor, es_persona_natural ORDER BY TotalMontoRecibido DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT RubroN1, SUM(totalLineaNeto) AS gasto_neto FROM oc_lineas WHERE monedaItem = 'CLP' AND NOT totalLineaNeto IS NULL GROUP BY RubroN1 ORDER BY gasto_neto DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Codigo) FROM oc_lineas WHERE ProcedenciaOC = 'Proveniente de licitación pública' LIMIT 100
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Codigo) AS cantidad_ordenes_emergencia FROM oc_lineas WHERE TRIM(ProcedenciaOC) = 'Emergencia, urgencia o imprevisto' LIMIT 100
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Codigo) FROM oc_lineas WHERE EsCompraAgil = 'Si' AND EsTratoDirecto IS DISTINCT FROM 'Si' LIMIT 100
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Codigo) AS ordenes_pendientes FROM oc_lineas WHERE Estado = 'Enviada a proveedor' LIMIT 100
SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN EsCompraAgil = 'Si' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS porcentaje_compras_agiles FROM oc_lineas WHERE TRIM(sector) = 'Salud' LIMIT 100
SELECT SUM(totalLineaNeto) AS total_vendido_clp FROM oc_lineas WHERE NombreProveedor = 'COPEC S.A.' AND monedaItem = 'CLP' AND Estado IN ('Recepcion Conforme', 'Aceptada') LIMIT 100

WITH ordenes_deduplicadas AS (SELECT Codigo, ANY_VALUE(MontoTotalOC_PesosChilenos) AS MontoTotalOC_PesosChilenos, ANY_VALUE(OrganismoPublico) AS OrganismoPublico FROM oc_lineas WHERE OrganismoPublico ILIKE 'I MUNICIPALIDAD DE TEMUCO' AND FechaEnvio >= '2026-01-01' AND FechaEnvio < '2026-02-01' GROUP BY Codigo) SELECT SUM(MontoTotalOC_PesosChilenos) AS TotalComprado FROM ordenes_deduplicadas LIMIT 100
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Codigo) AS cantidad_ordenes_recibidas FROM oc_lineas WHERE NombreProveedor = 'SODEXO SOLUCIONES DE MOTIVACION CHILE S.A.' LIMIT 100
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Codigo) AS cantidad_ordenes FROM oc_lineas WHERE OrganismoPublico ILIKE 'COMPLEJO ASISTENCIAL DR. SOTERO DEL RIO' LIMIT 100
SELECT SUM(totalLineaNeto) AS gasto_total_pesos_chilenos FROM oc_lineas WHERE sector = 'Salud' AND RubroN1 ILIKE '%Medicamentos%' AND monedaItem = 'CLP' LIMIT 100

SELECT SUM(totalLineaNeto) AS gasto_combustibles_clp FROM oc_lineas WHERE (RubroN1 ILIKE 'Combustibles, lubricantes y anticorrosivos' OR RubroN2 ILIKE 'Combustibles líquidos' OR RubroN2 ILIKE 'Combustibles gaseosos y aditivos' OR RubroN2 ILIKE 'Combustibles sólidos' OR NombreroductoGenerico ILIKE 'Filtros de combustible' OR NombreroductoGenerico ILIKE 'Recursos de madera combustible' OR NombreroductoGenerico ILIKE 'Bombas de combustible' OR RubroN3 ILIKE 'Combustibles gaseosos' OR RubroN3 ILIKE 'Combustible para vehículos de transporte, estacionamiento y otros servicios de apoyo' OR RubroN3 ILIKE 'Combustibles sólidos' OR NombreProveedor ILIKE 'DISTRIBUIDORA DE COMBUSTIBLE MRH SPA' OR OrganismoPublico ILIKE 'SUPERINTENDENCIA DE ELECTRICIDAD Y COMBUSTIBLES') AND monedaItem = 'CLP' LIMIT 100
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Codigo) FROM oc_lineas WHERE TRIM(RegionUnidadCompra) = 'Región del Biobío' LIMIT 100

WITH deduplicada AS (SELECT Codigo, ANY_VALUE(MontoTotalOC_PesosChilenos) AS MontoTotalOC_PesosChilenos, ANY_VALUE(sector) AS sector, ANY_VALUE(EsTratoDirecto) AS EsTratoDirecto FROM oc_lineas GROUP BY Codigo), trato_directo AS (SELECT sector, COUNT(DISTINCT Codigo) AS total_ordenes_trato_directo, SUM(MontoTotalOC_PesosChilenos) AS monto_total_trato_directo FROM deduplicada WHERE EsTratoDirecto = 'Si' GROUP BY sector), total_sector AS (SELECT sector, COUNT(DISTINCT Codigo) AS total_ordenes, SUM(MontoTotalOC_PesosChilenos) AS monto_total FROM deduplicada GROUP BY sector) SELECT t.sector, (t.monto_total_trato_directo / ts.monto_total) * 100 AS porcentaje_monto_trato_directo FROM trato_directo AS t JOIN total_sector AS ts ON t.sector = ts.sector ORDER BY porcentaje_monto_trato_directo DESC LIMIT 1

WITH ordenes_deduplicadas AS (SELECT Codigo, ANY_VALUE(MontoTotalOC_PesosChilenos) AS MontoTotalOC_PesosChilenos, ANY_VALUE(RegionUnidadCompra) AS RegionUnidadCompra, ANY_VALUE(sector) AS sector FROM oc_lineas WHERE sector = 'Salud' GROUP BY Codigo) SELECT RegionUnidadCompra, AVG(MontoTotalOC_PesosChilenos) AS PromedioMontoPorOrden FROM ordenes_deduplicadas GROUP BY RegionUnidadCompra ORDER BY PromedioMontoPorOrden DESC LIMIT 3
SELECT sector, COUNT(DISTINCT Codigo) AS cantidad_ordenes FROM oc_lineas WHERE MontoTotalOC_PesosChilenos > 1000000000 GROUP BY sector LIMIT 100
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Codigo) FROM oc_lineas WHERE sector = 'Salud' AND totalLineaNeto > 10000000 GROUP BY Codigo HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 LIMIT 100
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CodigoProveedor) AS ProveedoresConMasDe10Organismos FROM oc_lineas GROUP BY CodigoProveedor HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT CodigoOrganismoPublico) > 10 LIMIT 100
